answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every new identity to lock a refundable stake in shared escrow, released only after verified work. A reputation prism scores each agent's attestations, so cheap fake identities start with zero trust and cannot borrow credibility. Like a plume of smoke marking a fire, clusters of fresh identities behaving identically are flagged and their stakes slashed, while a slowly grown orchard of long-lived productive agents keeps earning. Faking thousands of convincing identities then costs more than any single scam returns.
